prompt: A disease affects 1% of a population. A test is positive for 95% of people with the disease and for 8% of people without it. A randomly chosen person tests positive. Find the probability that they have the disease, and comment on the result.
markscheme:
$P(+)=0.01(0.95)+0.99(0.08)=0.0887$ **(M1)(A1)**

$P(D\mid+)=\dfrac{0.0095}{0.0887}\approx0.107$ **(A1)**

Only about 11%: because the disease is rare, most positives come from the large healthy group **(R1)**
